findings.claim: The tx-edu-001 fix only rejects setAutoCommit(true) when it appears before the last executeUpdate or before conn.commit(). A catch block that restores auto-commit before rolling back, catch (SQLException e) { conn.setAutoCommit(true); conn.rollback(); throw e; }, now passes every check (verified by running the extracted t3Check in node), although the page's own Problems message says to restore it only after commit() and rollback(). Per the java.sql.Connection contract, changing auto-commit during a transaction commits it, and rollback() in auto-commit mode throws, so the accepted code would replace the original failure with a different exception.
findings.recommendation: Also flag setAutoCommit(true) when it appears inside the catch before conn.rollback() (for example, reject when on > cat && on < rb), keeping the finally-block restore accepted.
